class.name: SteamStatsSubmissionResult
class.brief_description: The local result of applying a stats draft and asking Steam to persist it.
class.description: Successful submission means Steam accepted the cache changes and the request to store them. Observe [signal SteamStats.stats_stored] for app-wide persistence outcomes.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the edit counters, including on failure.

members.member: Read-only edit counters produced by [method SteamStatsEdit.submit]. Available for successful, failed, and partially applied drafts.
